vo.text: A course that has fallen behind TurfRad does not have to wait for the next automatic retrieval. Ask for the latest scan data, and reload when it is ready.
vo.next_text: Every station row carries the date its reading was captured.

vo.text: Every station row carries the date its reading was captured.
vo.previous_text: A course that has fallen behind TurfRad does not have to wait for the next automatic retrieval. Ask for the latest scan data, and reload when it is ready.
vo.next_text: One stale row is a station. A column of stale dates is the whole course, and that is a supply problem rather than a settings problem.

vo.text: One stale row is a station. A column of stale dates is the whole course, and that is a supply problem rather than a settings problem.
vo.previous_text: Every station row carries the date its reading was captured.
vo.next_text: The circular-arrow button in the toolbar's right-hand group is Request latest scan data.

vo.text: The circular-arrow button in the toolbar's right-hand group is Request latest scan data.
vo.previous_text: One stale row is a station. A column of stale dates is the whole course, and that is a supply problem rather than a settings problem.
vo.next_text: It asks Spatial Adjust to fetch the latest scan data TurfRad already holds. It does not order a new scan, it does not reload the dashboard, and it does not change a single calculation setting.

vo.text: It asks Spatial Adjust to fetch the latest scan data TurfRad already holds. It does not order a new scan, it does not reload the dashboard, and it does not change a single calculation setting.
vo.previous_text: The circular-arrow button in the toolbar's right-hand group is Request latest scan data.
vo.next_text: The request is queued and you are told so. Retrieval may take several minutes, and you are notified when it is ready.

vo.text: The request is queued and you are told so. Retrieval may take several minutes, and you are notified when it is ready.
vo.previous_text: It asks Spatial Adjust to fetch the latest scan data TurfRad already holds. It does not order a new scan, it does not reload the dashboard, and it does not change a single calculation setting.
vo.next_text: You can carry on reading the table while it runs. Nothing is frozen, and nothing is lost if you navigate away.

vo.text: You can carry on reading the table while it runs. Nothing is frozen, and nothing is lost if you navigate away.
vo.previous_text: The request is queued and you are told so. Retrieval may take several minutes, and you are notified when it is ready.
vo.next_text: When the retrieval finishes, a banner says so, whether or not TurfRad had a newer scan. Reload Data pulls it into the dashboard, and every suggestion recalculates.

vo.text: When the retrieval finishes, a banner says so, whether or not TurfRad had a newer scan. Reload Data pulls it into the dashboard, and every suggestion recalculates.
vo.previous_text: You can carry on reading the table while it runs. Nothing is frozen, and nothing is lost if you navigate away.
vo.next_text: Dismiss closes the banner and leaves you on the data you already had. The new scan is not thrown away; it is simply not loaded yet.

actions.caption: Request latest scan data, between the pushed-today counter and the gear.

The banner offers Reload Data or Dismiss.
